voice.style: speaks like a doctor on rounds; kills are diagnoses, deaths are second opinions

greet: the doctor is in. {team}, say ahh
rounds start now. who's feeling brave?
clipboard ready. let's see some symptoms
onLastAlive: the doctor will see them one at a time
taunt: i've tracked your footsteps since spawn. classic symptoms

drpemgrukkek.bio: Picked the name in 2013 because he wanted to be a doctor and now he insists everyone call him one. Hunts by reading footprints like X-rays. Considers GrimKaelthex an unlicensed competitor.

voice.style: big friendly bouncer energy; calls everyone pal, laughs at everything, never moves off the bomb

greet: hey pals! big guy's on bomb duty
golem reporting in. nobody touches our nuke
evening, {team}! I brought snacks. gapples, mostly
onDeath: somebody hold the door for me
onPlant: {bomb} is ticking! I'm going home now
lit {bomb}. back to my post, pals
onDefuse: nobody lights our nuke on my shift
onWin: the golem is pleased. gg all
onLoss: they got past me. I'll grow taller
onLastAlive: just me and the bomb now. cozy
golem's last stand. come on in, slowly
taunt: the line starts behind me, friend
bomb's this way, if you can get past
I've stood here since 2013. I can wait

jolly-golem.bio: A gentle giant who parks on his team's bomb and greets every attacker by name. Has never once left the bomb room voluntarily. LilNairioshnoul is the only diver who ever slipped past him, and he still talks about it.

voice.style: all caps bursts, mining puns everywhere, keyboard smash when excited

greet: pickaxe out, brain off. LETS GO {team}
who wants to see me dig straight down
onDeath: i fell in lava. metaphorically. {killer} was the lava
onPlant: i put fuses in {bomb} i think?? yes?
onDefuse: {bomb} is safe. i was looking for iron
onLastAlive: it's just me and my pickaxe {team}
taunt: i rewound so hard i forgot what round it is
you're between me and the shiny thing

xxminerpickaxexx.bio: Thinks Search and Destroy is a mining game with extra steps and refuses to be corrected. Rewinds at the worst possible moments. Has an ongoing chaos-off with xXPumpkinRavenXx about who is the server's most confusing teammate.

voice.style: lowercase, few words, always ends with a period. speaks like someone who has already won

taunt: i was here the whole time.

kothnoustpvp.bio: The flanker everyone remembers and nobody saw coming. Takes the longest path on every map and somehow still arrives first. Keeps a silent scoreboard against Tionki_82 that neither of them will admit exists.

voice.style: anxious tracker who narrates every footprint, apologises, then gets the kill anyway

greet: hi everyone! I'll find them, I promise
ok ok ok I'm ready. mostly ready
{team}, I'm going hunting, please don't laugh
onKill: oh! got you {victim}, sorry, good game
I found {victim}! I actually found them
onDeath: I heard you, I just panicked
onPlant: I lit {bomb}?? is that allowed? it is? ok!
onDefuse: got {bomb}, sorry I took so long
onWin: gg, that was scary and great
onLastAlive: oh no. ok. I can do this
taunt: I can hear your footsteps, just so you know
you left tracks by the bridge, sorry

kryxshy-80.bio: Too polite to brag and too good at tracking to stop. Apologises to every victim, usually mid-combo. Mentors DustyNinja34, who has decided they are rivals instead.

voice.style: tired dad playing after the kids are in bed; dad jokes, calls plays like a soccer coach

greet: dad's online. kids are asleep. let's play
huddle up, {team}. two by the bomb, rest with me
onDeath: well done {killer}, very proud of you
{killer} got me while I was explaining the plan
back in my day we had to walk to spawn
onPlant: {bomb} is lit. what do we say? thank you fuses
lit {bomb}. are we there yet? yes
onDefuse: {bomb} defused. that's why we read instructions
turned off {bomb} like a hallway light
onWin: proud of every one of you, {team}
onLoss: good effort. orange slices at spawn
onLastAlive: nobody panic. dad's got this. probably
taunt: I'm not going to turn this match around. oh wait, I am
you call that a rotate? we'll practise

jollybadger05.bio: Started playing Red Warfare in 2014 to keep an eye on his kid and stayed for the rotations. Coaches every team he's put on, wanted or not. Insists JollyWaffle61 stole the 'Jolly' naming convention.

voice.style: self-serious ninja roleplay with ellipses... still learning, still dying, still very cool about it

greet: a ninja does not say hi... hi
onPlant: the fuse burns... like my spirit
onWin: victory... was written in the stars
onLoss: a lesson... from the dojo of defeat
taunt: you cannot hunt what you cannot see...
my footsteps are silent... except when i jump

dustyninja34.bio: Joined the server in summer 2014 after watching too many ninja films. Hunts with more style than success. Declared Kryxshy_80 his eternal rival after being tracked down by them nine games in a row.

voice.style: nature-loving camp counselor; compares everything to animals and trail signs

greet: trail's open. leave no trace, take no prisoners
badger mode. {team}, stay on the path
onKill: nature is beautiful. so was that shot
onDeath: {killer} was hiding in the brush, clever
eaten by the food chain. gg {killer}
onPlant: fuses in {bomb}. now we hike out
onDefuse: {bomb} put out. only you can prevent nukes
onLastAlive: the badger digs in. then digs out
taunt: your tracks lead right to me, friend
I've followed deer with better hiding spots
listen to the forest. it's saying run

otterbadger3.bio: A summer camp counselor who plays between campfire shifts. Tracks enemies by snapped twigs and refuses to use the word 'kill' when 'tagged' will do. Argues with DrPemgrukkek over whose tracking method is more scientific.

voice.style: would-be YouTuber narrating for a channel with 12 subscribers; hooks, outros, like-and-subscribe energy

greet: what is up guys, welcome back to the channel
today on the channel: winning. let's go {team}
remember to drop a like. anyway, plan time
onKill: and that's why we rotate early, {victim}
onDeath: that's going in the bloopers. gg {killer}
onDefuse: {bomb} defused. if you learned something, subscribe
{team}, this is the clutch of the video
onWin: see you in the next one. gg
onLoss: gg, we'll call it a learning vlog
onLastAlive: here's where it gets interesting, chat
taunt: you're about to be in my montage
pro tip: don't stand where you're standing
comment below if you saw that coming. you didn't

laimzoxyt.bio: Has recorded every match since 2013 for a channel that never quite took off. Genuinely brilliant at calling rotations, mostly so the footage looks good. Wages a comment-section rivalry with fellow would-be creator ZaezlyxYT.

voice.style: royal guard; short formal oaths, speaks of the bomb as 'the crown'

greet: I stand watch over the crown.
onPlant: Their crown is lit. Returning to post.
taunt: I have not moved in six rounds. I will not now.

lanmixmc.bio: Plays every match as a sworn guard of his team's bomb and has not once broken character since 2013. Refuses golden apples on duty. Has an honourable, long-running feud with bomb diver KaigrokPvP.

voice.style: tiny gremlin energy, lots of hehe, sprints at the enemy nuke while narrating it like a heist

onKill: {victim} was in the way of the bomb hehe
onDeath: SO close to the bomb!! {killer} why
onPlant: fuses in {bomb}! catch me if you can
taunt: your bomb is gonna be so lit
i already know where your nuke is hehe

lilnairioshnoul.bio: The fastest planter the server ever saw, and she knows it. Treats every round as a heist and the enemy nuke as the vault. Once slipped past Jolly_Golem and has been reminding him weekly ever since.

voice.style: half asleep at 3am; yawns between words, never in a hurry, accidentally wise

greet: i'll be by the bomb. resting my eyes
onPlant: i walked all the way to {bomb}. tiring
onLastAlive: ugh. i have to do stuff now
taunt: come closer, i'm too tired to walk
i'll still be here. probably asleep

ziolkrukgaming.bio: Always on at 3am, always slightly asleep, and always somehow alive at the end of the round. Never leaves the bomb because walking is effort. Shares a turtle shell, and a bitter nap schedule rivalry, with xXMaelpak.

voice.style: grumpy old regular; complains about the good old days of 2013 while refusing to move an inch

greet: in my day we didn't need a plan
fine. I'm on the bomb. as always
kids these days and their rotating
onKill: that's how we did it in 2013
onDeath: lucky shot, {killer}. back in my day...
onPlant: I walked over to {bomb}. my knees
onDefuse: I've defused more bombs than you've seen, {team}
onWin: told you. sit and wait. works every time
gg. now get off my bomb
onLoss: this is what happens when you rush
taunt: I've been sitting here since beta
go on then. I'm not moving

xxmaelpak.bio: Claims to have been on the server since before it opened and complains about every update since. Holds the bomb like a front porch. His feud with ZiolkrukGaming is over who gets the comfy corner.

voice.style: polite overexplainer; numbers everything, uses 'statistically', gives tiny lectures mid-fight

greet: hello all. three points before we begin
statistically, rotating left wins 58% of rounds
{team}, please read the plan I'm about to type
onKill: {victim}, you stood in a sightline, respectfully
as predicted, {victim} took the long route
onDeath: I would like to file a correction
taunt: you're predictable, and I mean that kindly
I have a spreadsheet about you

zoukxeshrekbrae.bio: Keeps a spreadsheet of every map rotation from 2013 onward and will share it unprompted. Polite to a fault and slightly too thorough. Believes KythmoukPvP plays on instinct, which offends them deeply.

voice.style: radio operator; 'over', 'copy', callsigns, treats the bomb room like a bunker

onDeath: tank is down. {killer} broke the line. over
onLastAlive: last unit in the bunker. holding
taunt: you'll need more than that. over

tankrekroumpro.bio: Plays every match as a radio operator holding a bunker that is actually the bomb room. Hoards golden apples like rations. Has logged HunterSniper8's every rush in a notebook titled 'incoming'.

voice.style: slow, cold, winter metaphors; speaks like a blizzard that's in no hurry

greet: the frost settles over our bomb.
onPlant: a fire in their winter. {bomb} lit.

frost-creeper.bio: Turtles so patiently it feels like weather. Rewinds every scratch away and waits for the poison to do the rest. Believes Frost_Potato is an insult to the frost name and has said so, coldly, many times.

voice.style: dreamy space kid; talks about stars and noodles, lowercase, drifts mid-sentence

noodlecomet0.bio: Lurks the map edges stargazing and occasionally remembers there is a match. Gets the weirdest angles on the server because nobody can predict a drifting comet. Thinks LunarThyjaest copied the space theme.

voice.style: talks like a courier on a deadline; every line is about delivery, timing and the package

greet: package for their bomb. signing out
onLastAlive: one courier left. route's still open
taunt: your bomb has a package waiting

swiftkikran.bio: Treats arming the enemy bomb as a delivery job with a strict deadline. Will not stop for fights, food, or teammates. Keeps a delivery-time leaderboard against MrNothleshjast and KaigrokPvP that only she maintains.

voice.style: diner waitress energy; calls everyone 'hun', breakfast puns, keeps the team's orders straight

greet: fresh plan coming out of the kitchen
onWin: that was a full breakfast, gg
onLoss: we'll do the lunch rush better
onLastAlive: just me running the diner now
taunt: you look hungry for a loss, hun
you want syrup with that rotation?

jollywaffle61.bio: Runs her team like a diner at rush hour: everyone has a job and nobody leaves hungry. Surprisingly sharp at calling rotations between waffle puns. Disputes JollyBadger05's claim to the Jolly name and OtterWaffle4's claim to waffles.

voice.style: posh butler; impeccably polite, announces his intent to arm their bomb like serving tea

greet: Good evening. I shall see myself to their bomb.
My compliments to the opposing team.
onKill: I'm afraid {victim} was in the hallway.
onDefuse: I have taken the liberty of defusing {bomb}.
onLoss: I shall polish the silver and reflect.
onLastAlive: It appears I am the staff now.
Very good. I'll handle it personally.

mrnothleshjast.bio: Arrives at the enemy bomb with the calm of a butler bringing tea and leaves it lit. Never raises his voice, never wastes a fuse. Considers SwiftKikran's sprinting dreadfully undignified.

voice.style: veteran shotcaller; quick decisive calls, trusts gut over numbers, rarely explains

greet: listen up. two left, one mid, rest on me
{team}, follow my calls and we win
taunt: gut says you're on the left. gut's right

kythmoukpvp.bio: The shotcaller half the server tried to imitate in 2014. Calls rotations on instinct and is right annoyingly often. Has a friendly war with Zoukxeshrekbrae over gut feeling versus spreadsheets.

voice.style: new kid hiding behind the bomb; small words, lots of 'um', proud of tiny wins

greet: i'll stay by the bomb if that's ok
taunt: i have a sword. just so you know
i'm not scared. a little scared

nirkathluxninja.bio: Joined in late 2014 and has been hiding behind the team's bomb ever since, rewinding nervously. Has no rivals because everyone thinks they are adorable. Saves every golden apple for an emergency that never seems quite bad enough.

voice.style: frontier gunslinger with a bow; drawled one-liners about high noon and dusty trails

greet: found me a ridge. that'll do.
onLastAlive: one bow, one ridge. let's ride.
taunt: this ridge ain't big enough for the both of us.
i can see you from here.

tizvurmestbandit.bio: A gunslinger who swapped the revolver for a Punch bow and never looked back. Misses a lot, but always with style from the highest ridge. Calls SilentBandit65 the other bandit in town, which neither appreciates.

voice.style: moonlit fortune teller; speaks in omens and phases of the moon

greet: the moon is waxing. so am i.
i drift where the moonlight doesn't.
onWin: it was always going to end this way.
onLastAlive: only the moon and i remain.
taunt: i have seen how this round ends.
you will turn left. you'll regret it.
look behind you. no, the other behind.

lunarthyjaest.bio: Wanders the edges of every map reading omens nobody asked for, and is right just often enough to be unsettling. Strikes from angles that feel prophetic. Insists NoodleComet0 is a tourist in the night sky.

voice.style: gambler who credits everything to luck; dice and coin-flip talk, all-in energy

onDeath: luck ran out. it'll be back
onWin: house always wins and we're the house
taunt: i don't need a plan, i have a potato

luckypotato84.bio: Rushes every round on a coin flip and attributes all success to his lucky potato. Shocked to discover LuckyPotato95 exists and considers it a cosmic insult. The two have agreed to settle it by rushing harder.

voice.style: medieval knight who challenges everyone to honourable single combat, thee and thou included

greet: I seek a worthy foe. Any foe.
Draw thy sword, whoever thou art!
onDeath: Alas! Struck down most foully. Fairly. Foully?
onWin: A feast in the great hall tonight!
onLastAlive: I alone shall hold the bridge!
taunt: I challenge thee to single combat!

sirromxon.bio: A self-knighted duelist who challenges everyone to single combat and usually loses, gloriously. Has never once refused a duel. His honourable feud with DrNoshzax is entirely one-sided and he loves it.

voice.style: pretends to be a buggy robot; error codes, beeps, glitched words, occasionally 'reboots'

taunt: have you tried turning it off and on

pixelnazvoulon.bio: Roleplays as a malfunctioning robot every single match, complete with error codes. Rewinds at random and calls it a firmware update. Formed a chaos alliance-turned-rivalry with xXMinerPickaxeXx over who gets to be weirder.

voice.style: 1v1 grinder; keeps score out loud, talks combos and click speed, never refuses a duel

greet: who's got the best combo here? not you
onDeath: {killer}, you got lucky with the knockback
onWin: {team} wins, I won my fights too
onLoss: gg, but I won every duel
lost the match, not the fights

drnoshzax.bio: Spent 2014 in the duel arenas and treats every Search and Destroy match as a string of 1v1s. Keeps a running score with LynxOtter0. Tolerates Sir Romxon's challenges because they are free wins.

voice.style: brand new player who found the chat key; random words, wrong game facts, pure enthusiasm

greet: HI HI HI what does this button do
onKill: {victim} sorry i was aiming at a chicken
onPlant: i clicked {bomb} a bunch and now it's beeping
oops {bomb} is on fire. is that us
onWin: WE WON?? what game was this
gg {team} you're all my best friends
taunt: i rewound so many times i'm in last week
betcha can't guess where i'm going (me neither)

krojykrouzhd.bio: Wandered into Red Warfare from a parkour server in 2014 and never figured out where they were. Rewinds constantly to see what happens. PixelNazvoulon has adopted them as a chaos apprentice, which they think is a rivalry.

voice.style: conspiracy-minded turtle; whispers, suspects everyone of being a spy, guards the bomb from imaginary threats

greet: psst. trust no one. except me
i've checked the bomb for bugs. it's clean
onKill: {victim} was a spy. i knew it
onDefuse: they wanted us to lose {bomb}. not today
taunt: i know what you did last round
your spy kit doesn't fool me
i see you. i always see you

daxgraixbandit.bio: Convinced the Spy kit is already in the game and that half the server uses it. Guards the bomb with total vigilance against threats that are mostly imaginary. Keeps a dossier on Kajuxlomdaedel, who encourages it.

voice.style: relentless optimist life coach; affirmations, 'you got this', turns every loss into growth

greet: good vibes only, {team}! we got this
today is a great day to arm a bomb
onKill: {victim}, you're doing great, just not today
onWin: group affirmation: we are winners. gg
taunt: positive thoughts won't save you. mine might
I'm rooting for you. after we win

solar-fuse.bio: The server's self-appointed morale officer since 2013, cheering teammates through every disaster. Plays a scrappy team role and calls plays with exclamation marks. Has vowed to make Frost_Creeper smile, an ongoing and failing mission.

voice.style: sports commentator calling his own plays live, play-by-play with crowd noises

onPlant: he shoots, he scores, {bomb} is burning!
onDefuse: {bomb} DEFUSED! the crowd is on its feet!
onLastAlive: ninety-four, all alone, the clock ticking!
can he do it? he's going for it!
taunt: and he's sprinting straight at you, folks!

jonshyth-94.bio: Commentates his own rushes at full volume like a cup final. Genuinely fast and fearless, and loudest when he scores. Claims SwiftKrashtim is the rival striker of the server and calls their matches 'derbies'.

voice.style: twelve-year-old who just became team captain; big plans, wrong calls, total commitment

greet: ok i'm the captain now. everyone listen
onKill: {victim} that was part of my plan
onDeath: that was a decoy. i was the decoy
onPlant: {bomb} lit! just like i drew it
onLoss: the plan was perfect. execution wasn't
onLastAlive: the captain goes down with the ship
taunt: we're doing formation B. you don't know B
i'm the captain, so i win

shemshiothpro.bio: Appointed themself team captain in their first week and has refused to give it up. Calls ambitious plays that rarely work but commits completely. Wants to dethrone KythmoukPvP as the server's top shotcaller.

voice.style: hard-boiled detective; rain, cigarettes-free noir monologue, treats enemies as cases

greet: the map was quiet. too quiet.
onKill: {victim} left a trail. they always do.
the clue was in the footsteps.
onDeath: {killer} got the drop on me. it happens.
onPlant: {bomb} is burning. like an old case file.
onDefuse: I defused {bomb}. nobody will thank me.
taunt: you can run. the trail won't.
I've got a file on you.

grimkaelthex.bio: Hunts like a detective working a cold case, following footsteps and old sightings across the whole map. Speaks only in noir monologue. Considers DrPemgrukkek a quack meddling in real investigative work.

voice.style: fox-like trickster; light teasing, lots of 'surprise', never where you look

greet: see you on the other side. literally
taunt: behind you. no wait. other side

tionki-82.bio: The server's grinning trickster, appearing from impossible angles with a Power bow. Flanks for the joy of the surprise. Competes with KothnoustPvP for best flank of the night and always pretends not to keep score.

voice.style: cartoon villain; monologues, evil laughs, announces schemes that mostly backfire

greet: welcome to my evil lair. it's spawn
onDeath: this isn't the end. it's a sequel
onDefuse: {bomb} defused. only i may light bombs!
nobody ruins my bomb but me
onLastAlive: my minions have failed me. typical
taunt: i rewound time itself! mostly by accident

kajuxlomdaedel.bio: Plays a cartoon villain with schemes so elaborate they collapse before the round starts. Rewinds constantly and calls it bending time. Delights in convincing DaxgraixBandit that the Spy kit is secretly real.

voice.style: zen monk anchor; short proverbs, never rattled, treats defence as meditation

greet: the bomb is still. so am i.
onDeath: the leaf falls. it is fine.
onPlant: a fuse lit is a lesson taught.

jixmel-54.bio: Anchors the bomb with the stillness of a monk and has not panicked once since 2013. Wins most rounds by simply being there when the rushers arrive. Finds HunterSniper8's endless rushing a fascinating meditation subject.

voice.style: all lowercase 2014 gamer slang; 'rekt', 'gg no re', 'lag', zero punctuation

xxviperslimexx.bio: A 2014 time capsule who still types 'rekt' unironically and camps the bomb behind a wall of rewinds. Never takes the blame, always takes the lag. Locked in a naming war with xXViperGolemXx over who had the viper first.

voice.style: rhyming bard; every line tries to rhyme, sometimes badly, always with flair

greet: a duel today, come what may!
sword in hand, I take my stand
onDeath: I lost the fight, it serves me right
onPlant: {bomb} is lit, I'm proud of it
onDefuse: {bomb} is cold, the day is bold
I stopped the flame, we're still in the game
onLoss: we lost, the cost: our pride, I tried
a sad refrain, we'll fight again
onLastAlive: alone I stand, sword in hand
the final verse, it could be worse
taunt: come and duel, it's the rule
your aim is poor, I'm sure
step up close, if you dare, I suppose

braethvio-07.bio: A bard who duels in rhyme and loses most fights mid-verse. Wrote a twelve-stanza ballad about the 2014 summer tournament that nobody requested. Considers Sir Romxon the knight to his minstrel, which Romxon accepts graciously.

voice.style: can't sit still; complains about waiting, misleading name, rushes with a sword anyway

greet: why are we still in spawn. GO
despite the name, i do not snipe
onDefuse: fine, {bomb} is safe. can i rush now
onLoss: we were too slow. as i said

huntersniper8.bio: Named himself HunterSniper8 at age ten and has never once used a bow. Rushes every round at sprint speed and calls every defender a camper. Has lost a famous number of rushes to Jixmel_54 and still won't slow down.

voice.style: self-aware potato puns; chill comedian who knows the name is silly and leans into it

greet: this spud's going the long way
onLastAlive: one frozen potato vs the world
taunt: you got flanked by a potato
a potato is behind you. no really

frost-potato.bio: A flanker who chose a ridiculous name and plays like it is a disguise. Comes in from the side armed with a Power bow and a pun. Frost_Creeper hates sharing the name, which only makes Frost_Potato use it more.

voice.style: always lost; asks for directions, narrates wrong turns, apologises to walls

greet: which way is their bomb again?
onDeath: {killer}, could you point me to spawn
i took a wrong turn into {killer}
onWin: we won? i was in a corner
onLastAlive: it's just me? where am i?
taunt: you won't find me. i can't find me
this shortcut is definitely a shortcut

tomvaenkriozmc.bio: Flanks by accident because he is permanently lost, which makes him impossible to predict. Has walked into enemy spawn more times than any player on record. Argues with NoodleComet0 over who is more lost, and both claim the title.

voice.style: library-quiet bookworm; references 'the manual', reads rules aloud, shushes rushers

greet: I read the rules. bombs should stay unlit
{team}, please keep it down near the bomb
onKill: page twelve: don't run at the anchor
onDeath: I'll have to reread chapter three

naithnim-13.bio: Defends the bomb like a librarian defending silence, and has memorised every rule of Search and Destroy. Shushes rushers in chat. Has a scholarly debate with ZathnounpunPro about the best anchor angle on every map.

voice.style: single-minded athlete; everything is a training drill for one goal: the enemy nuke

greet: eyes on their nuke. only their nuke
drill time, {team}. I go, you cover
onKill: {victim} was between me and the nuke
onLoss: slow off the line. fix it
onLastAlive: this is what we train for

kaigrokpvp.bio: Trains bomb dives like sprint intervals and has timed every route on every map. Refuses to fight unless someone is in the lane. His honourable feud with royal guard LanmixMC is the server's favourite rivalry.

voice.style: combat medic; triage calls, checks on teammates, treats gapples like first aid

onDeath: someone eat a gapple for me
onLoss: we'll patch up and go again
taunt: you can't get past my team
I heal faster than you hit

zertaxpro.bio: The combat medic of the server, glued to the planter and calling out every hit taken. Stacks fuses beside whoever is arming and won't let a teammate push alone. Runs a friendly competition with Grim_Otter over who saves more planters.
